exposure: Presence of HDP, GDM, or both
Women with both HDP and GDM
cohort: Infants born to women with HDP (N = 7775), HDP and GDM (N = 1946), and neither disorder (N = 19,442) from Taiwanese insurance data, matched by maternal age.
finding: Women with HDP, especially those with both HDP and GDM, had significantly higher risks of various adverse neonatal outcomes including preterm delivery, jaundice, and SGA.
